resources.string:
1. Copy the webhook from your Grok Bot. Open the bot in the Grok Bot app, open its “Ask about what's on my screen” routine, open the webhook panel, and copy the URL and the Authorization header.

2. Make Ask Button your digital assistant.

3. Send a test. A real ask uses the same path.
Paste the URL from the Grok Bot routine webhook panel.
Paste the Authorization header from that same panel. It usually starts with Bearer.
Screenshots and screen text go only to your own Grok Bot webhook, never to a third party.
Webhook must be an https URL.
Couldn\'t store the secret on this phone.
This phone has no digital assistant slot. Use the Quick Settings tile.

Long-press the Home button. On stock Android with gesture navigation, you can also swipe in from a bottom corner when that gesture is turned on.\n\nSamsung One UI 7 has no corner swipe. Add the Ask Button Quick Settings tile, or long-press the app icon and tap Ask about this screen. A power button shortcut is optional.

A bot can open androidassistbot://setup?webhook=…&auth=… after install. A QR code of that link works with the camera app. auth is the Authorization header value, usually Bearer and the key. The link contains the secret.
Or type a question. Send can be empty.
Allow the microphone in Ask Button, or type your question.
Voice isn\'t available. Type your question.
On-device voice failed. Type your question.
Didn\'t catch that. Type your question, or send the screen.
